acceptedAnswer.text: While any licensed electrician can perform the work, it's beneficial to hire one experienced in residential kitchen lighting design and installation, particularly within Bay Area regulations. Our team is familiar with local building codes and permitting requirements specific to cities like Pacifica, Daly City, and South San Francisco. This ensures your installation is not only aesthetically pleasing and functional but also meets all safety standards and legal mandates, potentially avoiding future issues or delays. We handle all necessary permits.
acceptedAnswer.description: A licensed electrician experienced in residential kitchen lighting, and familiar with Bay Area building codes, is recommended to ensure proper installation and compliance.
